climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Gris and Riesling sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A small, young South Island region registered as a geographical indication in 2018, with commercial planting from 2001. Limestone slopes, river gravels and a cool Pacific-influenced climate shape its Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Chardonnay and Riesling, known for freshness and restrained structure.
